meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 在项目里添加 DeltaChat 频道适配器：复制适配器与注册测试文件、安装 @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server、在 .env 填邮箱凭据并重启服务。之后机器人通过邮箱端到端加密收发 DeltaChat 消息和文件附件。
howto.when: 当你要求为 NanoClaw 添加 DeltaChat 频道时触发。若适配器文件、注册 import 和依赖已存在，则跳过这些安装步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 DeltaChat 频道接进来
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖，并提示配置 .env 凭据

say.text: 在日志里找出 DeltaChat 的邀请链接
say.note: 输出 invite URL 和二维码 SVG 的位置

say.text: 把这张图设为 DeltaChat 头像（配文 /set-avatar）
say.note: 仅 owner 或 admin 角色可用

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel adapter: copies adapter and test, installs @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server, sets email credentials in .env and restarts. Bot then exchanges DeltaChat messages and attachments over encrypted email.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a DeltaChat channel to NanoClaw; if the adapter file, registration import and dependency already exist, the install steps are skipped.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dependency, then asks for .env credentials

say_en.text: Find the DeltaChat invite link in the logs
say_en.note: Prints the invite URL and QR SVG path

say_en.text: Set this image as the bot avatar with /set-avatar
